deals.travelWindow: Sep 5-12 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Allegiant, additional Sept-Oct dates run higher
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $97 RT nonstop — down from $110 two weeks ago — and Great Smoky Mountains National Park's Sugarlands entrance is under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Market Square and the Old City are compact and easy to wander alone on foot, though a rental car is the only realistic way into the park itself.

highlights: Market Square's restaurants and farmers market
World's Fair Park and the Sunsphere
Old City's breweries and live music
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Sugarlands Visitor Center and Newfound Gap Road
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square for lunch, World's Fair Park and the Sunsphere in the afternoon, dinner in the Old City.
Day 2 — Knoxville Museum of Art in the morning, a walk along the Tennessee Riverwalk, brewery stop in the Old City at night.
Day 3 — Rent a car for the Smokies: Newfound Gap Road up to Clingmans Dome trailhead, back to Knoxville for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown Knoxville — Market Square, World's Fair Park, and the Old City — is entirely walkable; a rental car is required for the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square — walkable to restaurants and a short drive from I-40.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 15-22 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $187 RT nonstop, and Everglades City's Ten Thousand Islands entrance to Everglades National Park is about 75 minutes south.
deals.soloWhy: The River District downtown is small and safe to explore on foot, and Sanibel's beaches and wildlife drive are an easy solo day trip without a tour group.

highlights: River District's riverfront restaurants and galleries
Ding Darling National Wildlife Refuge's Wildlife Drive
Everglades City airboat tours and Ten Thousand Islands
itinerary: Day 1 — Edison and Ford Winter Estates in the morning, River District for dinner and live music.
Day 2 — Drive to Sanibel for shelling on the beach and the Ding Darling refuge's Wildlife Drive at sunset.
Day 3 — Drive to Everglades City for a Ten Thousand Islands boat tour before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The River District is walkable, but a rental car is essential for Sanibel and the Everglades.
guide.stayArea: Downtown River District — walkable to restaurants and close to the river.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 6-12 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Frontier
deals.whyRanked: $196 RT nonstop — no national park nearby, but the price and easy solo logistics (transit-friendly downtown, no rental car required if skipping the parks) keep it in the top five.
deals.soloWhy: Lake Eola Park and the Mills 50 district are walkable and low-key outside of the theme parks, with the free LYMMO bus covering downtown.

highlights: Lake Eola Park's swan boats and Sunday farmers market
Winter Park's Park Avenue and scenic boat tour
itinerary: Day 1 — Lake Eola Park in the morning, Orlando Museum of Art in the afternoon, dinner in Mills 50.
Day 2 — Harry P. Leu Gardens, then Winter Park's Park Avenue shops and the Scenic Boat Tour along the chain of lakes.
Day 3 — A slower morning at a Thornton Park coffee shop before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Winter Park are walkable in sections with the free LYMMO bus linking them; a rental car opens up the theme parks and Ocala National Forest.
guide.stayArea: Thornton Park or Downtown — walkable to Lake Eola and a LYMMO stop.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 3-10 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on American
deals.whyRanked: $210 RT nonstop, and Everglades National Park's main entrance near Homestead is under an hour away — a stronger park boost than the similarly priced Tampa fare, which has jumped it a spot.
deals.soloWhy: South Beach and Wynwood are walkable and full of counter-seating spots, and rideshares easily cover the gap between neighborhoods without a car.

highlights: South Beach's Art Deco Historic District
itinerary: Day 1 — South Beach's Art Deco district in the morning, the beach in the afternoon, dinner in Wynwood.
Day 2 — Vizcaya Museum and Gardens, then Little Havana's Calle Ocho for coffee and dinner.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Everglades NP: the Anhinga Trail boardwalk for alligators and wading birds before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The Metromover is free downtown and rideshares cover South Beach, Wynwood, and Little Havana; a rental car is needed for the Everglades.
guide.stayArea: South Beach or Wynwood — walkable to the beach or the murals and galleries.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 19-30 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $207 RT nonstop with no national park nearby, though Weeki Wachee Springs State Park is an easy day trip and Tampa's Riverwalk is fully walkable.
deals.soloWhy: The Riverwalk connects downtown's museums and Ybor City by foot or the free trolley, making it easy to explore without a car for most of the trip.

highlights: Ybor City's Cuban heritage and cigar shops
Weeki Wachee Springs mermaid show and kayaking
itinerary: Day 1 — Tampa Riverwalk and the Tampa Museum of Art, dinner in Ybor City.
Day 2 — Ybor City's cigar shops and Centro Ybor in the morning, Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Weeki Wachee Springs: the mermaid show or a kayak paddle before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free TECO Line Streetcar covers downtown and Ybor City; a rental car is needed for Weeki Wachee.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near the Riverwalk — walkable to the streetcar and Curtis Hixon Park.
